value.cache_clear_logic: When num_matched < 8, self.prev_pts is set to None. On the subsequent frame, if self.prev_pts is None or len(self.prev_pts) < 100, goodFeaturesToTrack is invoked to re-detect features, skipping pose integration for that frame. When num_inliers_pose >= 8, self.prev_pts is updated with only pose inliers.

value.caption_discrepancy: Paper caption states Moderate is 22.5 deg/s, but flight execution script actually commands 20.0 deg/s.

motion_profile_definitions.B (Braking): Moderate cruise pitch (1.8 deg) with 4 discrete braking pulses at [4-5.5s, 8.5-10s, 13-14.5s, 17.5-19s] pulsing to -2.0 deg for 0.4s then holding 0.0 deg
motion_profile_definitions.S (Sharp Stop): Moderate-high cruise pitch (2.2 deg) with 2 abrupt full stops at [5.5-8.5s, 13.5-16.5s] pulsing to -3.0 deg for 0.5s then holding 0.0 deg for 2.5s
motion_profile_definitions.H (High-speed burst): Fast cruise pitch (3.5 deg) with 2 high-speed forward bursts at [5.0-7.5s, 13.0-15.5s] pitching to 5.5 deg (~3.5 m/s)

value.geometry_naming_discrepancy: Paper describes C, B, S, H as trajectory shapes 'Circle, Box, Straight line, Helix', but flight execution script defines them as pitch/velocity profiles 'Cruise, Braking, Sharp Stop, High-speed burst'.
value.yaw_continuous_ramp: YES. Yaw target is strictly a continuous unidirectional ramp defined by `yaw_target_deg = yaw_rate_deg_s * elapsed`.
